nodes.name: Design Document
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Design Document" (specification, 3 lines): Add three machine-readable evidence schemas, examples, a validator and unit tests. The validator fails closed on stale main, PR-head drift, absent/failing CI, merge-SHA mismatch and Jira projection authority leakage.

nodes.name: Requirements Document
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Requirements Document" (specification, 3 lines): SCRUM-120 binds gate evidence to exact GitHub refs, PR heads, merge SHAs and workflow runs. G5 is post-merge verification only. G6 is required for deployment, release, production data, secret, migration or destructive operations. Jira is projection only and cannot grant GWC authority.

nodes.name: Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Implementation Plan" (specification, 7 lines): - [x] Define exact GitHub evidence schemas and examples. - [x] Define G5 post-merge verification schema and examples. - [x] Define Jira projection-only schema. - [x] Add validator and negative tests. - [x] Add release note and G3 evidence.
